safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(لله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun that is the fāʿil (agent) of سبّح [Note: It has been said: the lām is redundant (zāʾida) and the Name of Majesty is the object of سبّح.]. (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ما. (في الأرض) attached to the ṣila of the second ما. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya)..
The clause «سبّح ... ما في السموات» has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «هو العزيز ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the Name of Majesty.

safi-cedvel:2-4.t:
* I'rab:
(من أهل) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of كفروا. (من ديارهم) attached to (أخرج). (لأوّل) attached to (أخرج) [Note: The lām is called the lām of timing (lām al-tawqīt), i.e. "at the first gathering".. Al-Zamakhsharī said: It is like the lām in His saying, Exalted is He: يا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَياتِي, and your saying: "I came for (i.e. at) such-and-such a time".. The expression is of the kind of annexing the adjective to the noun it qualifies, i.e. He is the One who expelled those who disbelieved at the time of the first gathering.]. (ما) negative. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (حصونهم) the fāʿil (agent) of the active participle مانعتهم. (من الله) attached to (مانعتهم), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "from Allah's punishment" [Note: (حصونهم) may be a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) and (مانعتهم) an advanced khabar (predicate), the clause being the khabar of أنّ.]. (الفاء) a conjunction. (حيث) an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (أتاهم). (في قلوبهم) attached to (قذف). (بأيديهم) attached to (يخربون). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (أولي) the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, since it is attached to (mulḥaq bi) the sound masculine plural.
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أخرج ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ما ظننتم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يخرجوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجوا..) is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظننتم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم مانعتهم..) is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظنّوا.
The clause «ظنّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ما ظننتم.
The clause «أتاهم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ظنّوا.
The clause «لم يحتسبوا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قذف ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أتاهم الله.
The clause «يخربون ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: It may be a ḥāl from the absent pronoun in (قلوبهم).].
The clause «اعتبروا ...» is in the position of the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "If this is the state of the disbelievers, then take a lesson from their condition".
The clause «يا أولى الأبصار ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
3- (الواو) resumptive. (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (عليهم) attached to (كتب). (اللام) occurring in the response of لولا. (في الدنيا) attached to (عذّبهم). (لهم) attached to an advanced khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب). (في الآخرة) a ḥāl from عذاب [Note: Or attached to the notion of settledness (al-istiqrār) to which (لهم) is attached.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن كتب) is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.. and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing).
The clause «لولا كتابة الجلاء ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كتب ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «عذّبهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لهم ... عذاب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: The clause was not conjoined to the apodosis because punishment in this world is precluded by the existence of the exile, but in the Hereafter it is not precluded; had the clause been conjoined to the apodosis, it would have entailed that punishment is precluded for them in the Hereafter.].
4- The reference in His saying (ذلك) is to the expulsion in this world and the punishment in the Hereafter..
(الواو) resumptive. (الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم شاقّوا ...) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause.
The clause «شاقّوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «من يشاقّ ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption confirming the content of what preceded.
The clause «يشاقّ ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «إنّ الله شديد ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation (taʿlīl) for the implied apodosis, i.e.: "Whoever opposes Allah, He will punish him, for Allah is severe in punishment."

* Morphology:
(2) مانعتهم: feminine of مانع, an active participle of the triliteral منع; its pattern is فاعل.
(حصونهم) plural of حصن, a noun for a fortified place; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn, and the pattern of حصون is فعول, with two ḍammas.
(3) الجلاء: an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb جلا. It contains ibdāl (substitution) of the wāw by hamza; its origin is جلاو: the wāw came at the end after a vowelless alif and was converted to hamza; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
- The expulsion of Banū al-Naḍīr..
When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Medina, Banū al-Naḍīr made a treaty with him on the terms that they would be neither against him nor for him. When the Muslims were defeated on the day of Uḥud, they grew doubtful and broke the treaty. Kaʿb ibn al-Ashraf went out with forty riders to Mecca and made an alliance with Abū Sufyān at the Kaʿba. So he ﷺ commanded Muḥammad ibn Maslama al-Anṣārī, who killed Kaʿb by stealth. Then the Prophet ﷺ went out against them with the army and besieged them for twenty-one nights, and approved the cutting down of their palm trees. When Allah cast terror into their hearts, they asked for peace, but he refused them anything but exile, on the terms that every three households could carry on one camel whatever of their goods they wished, except weapons. So they went into exile to Adhriʿāt and Arīḥāʾ in the land of Syria. This exile was the first of their gatherings; the middle of their gatherings was ʿUmar's, may Allah be pleased with him, expelling them from Khaybar to Syria; and the last of their gatherings is the Day of Resurrection.

safi-cedvel:5-6.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governing word being قطعتم. (من لينة) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما [Note: Or it is the tamyīz (specification) of ما.]. (أو) a conjunction, and the wāw in (تركتموها) is redundant (zāʾida), lengthening the vowel of the mīm (ishbāʿ). (قائمة) a ḥāl, accusative, from the absent pronoun that is the object [Note: It was not parsed as a second object because the meaning of transformation is absent.]. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (بإذن) attached to the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "فعلكم" (your doing) — or "قطعها" (its cutting). (الواو) a conjunction. (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl). (يخزي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām, and the agent is "هو", referring to the Name of Majesty..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخزي..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, it and what it is conjoined to, i.e.: "Allah permitted their cutting so as to gladden the believers and to disgrace the transgressors".
The clause «قطعتم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تركتموها ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(فعلكم) بإذن الله ...» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يخزي ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
6- (الواو) a conjunction. (ما أفاء) like ما قطعتم. (على رسوله) attached to (أفاء), and likewise (منهم). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis. (ما) negative. (عليه) attached to (أوجفتم). (خيل) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. (لا) redundant to emphasise the negation. (ركاب) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to خيل by the wāw, genitive in form. (الواو) a conjunction. (على من) attached to (يسلّط), and the agent of (يشاء) is a pronoun referring to the Name of Majesty. (الواو) a conjunction. (على كلّ) attached to the khabar (قدير).
The clause «ما أفاء الله ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ما قطعتم.
The clause «ما أوجفتم ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لكنّ الله يسلّط ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ما أفاء الله.
The clause «يسلّط ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of لكنّ.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of rectification (istidrāk).

* Morphology:
(5) لينة: a noun for the palm tree; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn. It has been said that the original ʿayn of the word is wāw, because it is from اللون (colour), and it was converted to yāʾ because of the kasra before it.. And it has been said that it is a yāʾ, from اللين (softness).
(6) أفاء: contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its analogy is like فاء.. See verse (226) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(ركاب) a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own root; it is the camels that are ridden, its singular being راحلة; its pattern is فعال, with kasra.

safi-cedvel:7-8.t:
* I'rab:
(ما أفاء ... من أهل) like ما أفاء ... منهم [Note: In the previous verse (6), and (ما) is a second object.
(2, 3) In verse (5) of the sūra, and ما is a mubtadaʾ.]
[Translator's note: The source note above appears to merge the texts of footnotes 1–3; the markers for footnotes 2 and 3 are the stray closing quotation marks after the two occurrences of "like ما قطعتم" below.]
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (لله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو". (الواو) a conjunction in the seven places, and the last one is resumptive. (اليتامى) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty — or to ذي — and likewise (المساكين، ابن). (كيلا) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and a particle of negation; the noun of (يكون) is a pronoun referring to the fayʾ. (بين) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to a naʿt (adjective) of دولة. (منكم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الأغنياء. (ما آتاكم) like ما قطعتم». (الفاء) connecting the apodosis. (ما نهاكم) like ما قطعتم». (عنه) attached to (نهاكم). (فانتهوا) like فخذوه..
The clause «ما أفاء الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «(هو) لله ...» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يكون دولة ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (كي).
The interpreted maṣdar (كيلا يكون..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the lām, attached to an omitted verb, i.e.: "He made the fayʾ thus so that it would not be ...".
The clause «آتاكم الرسول ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ما أفاء الله.
The clause «خذوه ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما نهاكم عنه ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آتاكم الرسول.
The clause «نهاكم عنه ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «انتهوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of the second condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الله شديد ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
8- (للفقراء) a badal (substitute) for ذي القربى, with repetition of the preposition [Note: Or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اعجبوا" (wonder). The speech is then resumed anew.]. The wāw in (أخرجوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (من ديارهم) attached to the verb أخرجوا. (من الله) attached to (يبتغون). (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) for emphasis [Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الصادقون.. and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.]..
The clause «أخرجوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يبتغون ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «ينصرون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause يبتغون.
The clause «أولئك ... الصادقون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(7) دولة: a noun meaning "something circulated"; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(نهاكم) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion): the original of the alif is yāʾ; it was vowelled after a fatḥa and converted to alif; of the class of فتح.
(انتهوا) contains iʿlāl by making vowelless (taskīn) and iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is انتهيوا, with a yāʾ before the wāw. The ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless and the vowel was transferred to the hāʾ — iʿlāl by taskīn. Two sukūns met, on the wāw and the yāʾ, so the yāʾ was deleted to escape the two vowelless letters..
Its pattern is افتعوا.

* Rhetoric:
Disjunction (al-faṣl): in His saying, Exalted is He: ما أَفاءَ اللَّهُ عَلى رَسُولِهِ.
Disjunction is leaving a clause unconjoined to another; its opposite is conjunction (al-waṣl), which is conjoining some clauses to others. Since there is complete unity between this verse and the verse before it, the two verses were disjoined. Disjunction is in itself eloquence: someone was asked, "What is eloquence?" and he said:
"Knowing disjunction and conjunction."

* Benefits:
- The ruling on fayʾ:
The discussion of the ruling on spoils of war (ghanīma) has preceded at the opening of Sūrat al-Anfāl. As for the ruling on fayʾ, it belonged to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during his lifetime, to place it wherever he wished. He used to spend from it on his family their maintenance for a year, and put what remained into horses and weapons, as provision in the way of Allah. The scholars differed over fayʾ after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Some said: It belongs to the imams after him. Al-Shāfiʿī has two views on it: one, that it belongs to the fighters; the second, that it is for the welfare of the Muslims, beginning with the fighters, then the most important of the interests, then the next most important. They differed over taking a fifth of fayʾ property: most of the people of knowledge held that a fifth is not taken from it, but all of it is spent on the welfare of all the Muslims. ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, may Allah be pleased with him, recited (ما أَفاءَ اللَّهُ عَلى رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرى) until he reached (للفقراء المهاجرين), up to His saying وَالَّذِينَ جاؤُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ, then said: "This has encompassed the Muslims generally." He said: "There is no Muslim on the face of the earth but that he has a right in this fayʾ, except those whom your right hands possess."

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (من قبلهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تبوّؤا) [Note: Or attached to the implied verb that governs الإيمان: "ألفوا الإيمان" (they became familiar with faith), the conjunction here being a conjoining of clauses.]. (إليهم) attached to (هاجر). (لا) negative. (في صدورهم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ممّا) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of حاجة, the returning pronoun being omitted; and the wāw in (أوتوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (على أنفسهم) attached to (يؤثرون). (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (بهم) attached to the khabar (predicate) of كان. (الواو) parenthetical. (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nāʾib fāʿil of (يوق) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to من. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (أولئك هم المفلحون) like أولئك هم الصادقون [Note: In verse (8) of this sūra.].
The clause «الذين تبوّؤا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تبوّؤا الدار ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «(ألفوا) الإيمان ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يحبّون ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of تبوّؤا, if (الذين) is parsed as conjoined by the wāw to الفقراء as a conjoining of single words.].
The clause «هاجر ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «لا يجدون ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يحبّون.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يؤثرون ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يحبّون.
The clause «كان بهم خصاصة ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then they prefer others over themselves".
The clause «من يوق ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «يوق ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «أولئك ... المفلحون» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
10- (الواو) a conjunction. (الذين جاؤوا ... يقولون) like الذين تبوّؤا ... يحبّون. (من بعدهم) attached to (جاؤوا). (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative. (لنا) attached to (اغفر), and likewise (لإخواننا). (بالإيمان) attached to (سبقونا). (الواو) a conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (في قلوبنا) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. (للذين) attached to (غلّا) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of (غلّا).]..
The clause «الذين جاؤوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الذين تبوؤا.
The clause «جاؤوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يقولون ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: This clause may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of جاؤوا, if (الذين) is conjoined to (الذين تبوّؤا).. or have no grammatical position as an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «النداء وجوابه ...» (the vocative and its response) is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) [Note: The vocative clause may be parenthetical and the clause اغفر لنا the object of saying.].
The clause «اغفر لنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «سبقونا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا تجعل ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause اغفر لنا.].
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ربّنا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the saying [Note: Or resumptive, emphasising the first vocative clause.].
The clause «إنّك رؤف رحيم» has no grammatical position, being the response to the second vocative.

* Morphology:
(حاجة) see verse (68) of Sūrat Yūsuf.. What is meant by حاجة here is "envy, rage and rancour; it is a use of the entailing for the entailed, by way of metonymy (kināya), because these meanings are generally not separate from need" — from Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal.
(خصاصة) a noun for need and poverty; its origin is خصاص البيت, which are its gaps; the pattern of خصاصة is فعالة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(يوق) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion in keeping with the jussive, the lām (third radical) of the word having been deleted; its pattern is يفع, with ḍamma, then sukūn, then fatḥa..

* Rhetoric:
The device of concision (al-ījāz): in His saying, Exalted is He: وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّؤُا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمانَ.
The expression is of the type of: علفتها تبنا وماء باردا (I fed her straw and [gave her] cold water), i.e. they settled in the abode and made their faith sincere.
It has been said: settling (al-tabawwuʾ) is a non-metaphorical trope (majāz mursal) for adhering, which is its concomitant meaning; it is as if it were said: they adhered to the abode and to faith. And it has been said, in explaining it: the أل in الدار is for prior reference (ʿahd), meaning the abode of emigration, and it serves as well as an annexation; and in الإيمان there is the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "and the abode of faith", as if it were said: they settled in the abode of emigration and the abode of faith, the two abodes meaning Medina; the conjunction is as in your saying «رأيت الغيث والليث» (I saw the rain and the lion) when you mean Zayd.

safi-cedvel:11-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of wonder (al-istifhām al-taʿajjubī). (إلى الذين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ترى) in the meaning of "تنظر" (look). (لإخوانهم) attached to (يقولون). (من أهل) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of كفروا. (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle. (أخرجتم) a passive past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (اللام) the lām of the oath. (معكم) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (نخرجنّ) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl from the agent of going out, i.e. "being with you"..]. (الواو) a conjunction in the two places. (لا) negative. (فيكم) attached to (نطيع), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in humiliating you" — or "in forsaking you". (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the negated (نطيع). (قوتلتم) like أخرجتم. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for the oath paved for by the lām omitted from (إن). (الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath understood from the verb of testifying [Note: Or it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the hamza of (إنّ) was given kasra because of its presence, the original being that it have fatḥa.. The clause is then an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or an explanation of the verb of testifying.].
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «نافقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن أخرجتم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نخرجنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «لا نطيع ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
The clause «إن قوتلتم ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause إن أخرجتم.
The clause «ننصرنّكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «اللَّه يشهد ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive — or parenthetical. The clause «يشهد ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (اللَّه).
The clause «إنّهم لكاذبون ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath [Note: Or an explanatory resumption, or an explanation of the verb of testifying.].
12- (لئن أخرجوا) like لئن أخرجتم. (لا) negative. (معهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to the negated (يخرجون) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl from the agent of going out, i.e. "being with you".]. [Translator's note: The note reads "with you" (معكم), repeated from verse 11; the word here is معهم, "with them".] (لئن قوتلوا لا ينصرونهم) like لئن أخرجوا لا يخرجون.. (لئن) like the first. (نصروهم) a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) and (هم) the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (اللام) the lām of the oath. (يولّن) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was deleted because of the succession of like letters; (الواو), deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the agent, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis. (ثمّ) for conjunction. (لا) negative, and the wāw in (ينصرون) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «إن أخرجوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanation of the cause (taʿlīl) of the lying mentioned before.
The clause «لا يخرجون ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «إن قوتلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إن أخرجوا.
The clause «لا ينصرونهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «إن نصروهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إن أخرجوا.
The clause «يولّنّ الأدبار ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «لا ينصرون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يولّنّ....
13- (اللام) the lām of the inceptive (lām al-ibtidāʾ). (رهبة) tamyīz (specification), accusative. (في صدورهم) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in أشدّ, i.e. "keeping that secret". (من اللَّه) attached to (أشدّ). The reference in (ذلك) is to their fearing the created more than the Creator. (بأنهم قوم) an interpreted maṣdar in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك). (لا) negative..
The clause «أنتم أشدّ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يفقهون» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.
14- (لا) negative. (جميعا) a ḥāl from the agent of يقاتلون. (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr). (في قرى) attached to (يقاتلونكم). (أو) for conjunction. (من وراء) attached to (يقاتلونكم), so it is conjoined to the first preposition phrase. (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to the khabar (شديد). (جميعا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, i.e. "gathered together". (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (ذلك ... لا يعقلون) like ذلك ... لا يفقهون.
The clause «لا يقاتلونكم ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «بأسهم بينهم شديد» has no grammatical position, being another explanatory resumption.
The clause «تحسبهم جميعا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قلوبهم شتّى» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl [Note: Or it is a fresh resumption giving information.].
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause.
The clause «لا يعقلون» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(13) رهبة: an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رهب — in the passive form — its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(14) محصّنة: feminine of محصّن, a passive participle of the four-letter verb حصّن; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- The paving lām (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa)..
It is the lām that enters upon a conditional particle to announce that the response after it is built on an oath before it; hence it is called the announcing lām (al-lām al-muʾdhina), and it is also called the paving lām (al-muwaṭṭiʾa), because it paves the way for the response to the oath, i.e. prepares it for it, as in His saying, Exalted is He: لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا لا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ، وَلَئِنْ قُوتِلُوا لا يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ، وَلَئِنْ نَصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْأَدْبارَ. Most often it enters upon (إن). This lām may be omitted while the oath is implied before the condition, as in His saying, Exalted is He: وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ, and وَإِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهُوا عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ, for this can only be a response to an oath.

safi-cedvel:15-17.t:
* I'rab:
(كمثل) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "مثلهم" (their likeness). (من قبلهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun الذين. (قريبا) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to the notion of settledness (al-istiqrār) which is the khabar [Note: Or attached to (ذاقوا).]. (الواو) a conjunction. (لهم) attached to an advanced khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب)..
The clause «(مثلهم) كمثل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ذاقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ذاقوا.
16- (كمثل) like the first [Note: The first is about the Jews and the second about the hypocrites.]. (إذ) an adverb of past time in the position of the accusative, attached to the notion of settledness which is the khabar [Note: The meaning is: the hypocrites, in their inciting the Jews, resemble Satan when he said to man: Disbelieve.]. (للإنسان) attached to (قال). (الفاء) a conjunction. (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis قال. (منك) attached to (بريء). (ربّ) a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty, accusative..
The clause «(مثلهم) كمثل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قال ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اكفر ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كفر ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّي بريء ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «إنّي أخاف ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أخاف ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
17- (الفاء) resumptive. (في النار) attached to the khabar of أنّ. (خالدين) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of settledness which is the khabar of أنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهما في النار..) is in the position of the nominative as the postponed noun of كان.
(الواو) resumptive, and the reference in (ذلك) is to the punishment..
The clause «كان عاقبتهما ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ذلك جزاء» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause.

safi-cedvel:18-20.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) for أيّ — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). (الواو) a conjunction in the two places. (اللام) the lām of command. (لغد) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قدّمت). (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the returning pronoun being omitted.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون..) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate) (خبير).
The vocative clause «النداء ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «تنظر نفس ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «قدّمت ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «اتّقوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا (the first).
The clause «إنّ اللَّه خبير» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
19- (الواو) a conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (كالذين) attached to the khabar of تكونوا. (الفاء) a conjunction. (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is الفاسقون, the nominal clause being the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]..
The clause «لا تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «نسوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أنساهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause نسوا.
The clause «أولئك ... الفاسقون» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause.
20- (لا) negative. (الواو) a conjunction. (هم الفائزون) like هم الفاسقون.
The clause «لا يستوي أصحاب ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أصحاب الجنّة.. الفائزون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or explanatory of cause.

* Morphology:
(18) غد: a noun for the coming day, whether far or near; what is meant by it here is the Day of Resurrection, as if, because of its nearness, it were the next day, by way of metaphor (istiʿāra). Its pattern is فع, its lām (third radical) being deleted, since the noun of relation from it is غدويّ and غديّ.

* Rhetoric:
Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His saying, Exalted is He: وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ ما قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ.
He made both النفس and الغد indefinite. As for making النفس indefinite, it is to show how few are the souls that look into what they have sent ahead for the Hereafter, as if He said: let one single soul look into that. As for making الغد indefinite, it is to magnify it and leave its matter vague, as if it were said: (the morrow) — its true nature is not known because of its extreme greatness.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (على جبل) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلنا). (اللام) connecting the response. (خاشعا، متصدّعا) two ḥāls (circumstantials), accusative, from the absent pronoun in (رأيته). (من خشية) attached to (متصدّعا), and (من) is causal. (الواو) a conjunction. (تلك) a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: Or the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), explained by the one mentioned after it.]. (للناس) attached to (نضربها)..
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «رأيته ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تلك الأمثال نضربها» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نضربها ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (تلك).
The clause «لعلّهم يتفكّرون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يتفكّرون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(متصدّعا) an active participle of the five-letter verb تصدّع; its pattern is متفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:22-24.t:
* I'rab:
(الذي) a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty [Note: Or a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو.]. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (إلّا) for exception. (هو) a badal (substitute) for the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar. (عالم) a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو) [Note: Or a naʿt of the Name of Majesty.]..
The clause «هو اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «هو الرحمن ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption emphasising the content of what preceded, or for clarification.
23- (الملك) a naʿt of the Name of Majesty [Note: Or a khabar of the pronoun هو.
(2, 3) Or they are khabars of the mubtadaʾ هو.], and likewise the following attributes "2". (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. (عمّا) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (سبحان), and the returning pronoun of the relative noun is omitted.
[Translator's note: The source note above merges the texts of footnotes 1–3; markers "2" and "3" are the footnote numbers in this verse and the next.]
The clause «هو اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being an emphasising resumption.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذي).
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحان ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «يشركون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
24- (الخالق) a naʿt of the Name of Majesty, and likewise the following attributes "3". (له) attached to an advanced khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الأسماء). The second (له) is attached to (يسبّح) [Note: Or the lām is redundant (zāʾida) and the pronoun, in its second position, is the object of يسبّح.. or it is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun ما, the agent.]. [Translator's note: "in its second position" renders the source's «في محلّه الثاني», which appears garbled; the intended sense seems to be "in the position of the accusative as object".] (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila of ما. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — or a conjunction.
The clause «هو اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being an emphasising resumption.
The clause «له الأسماء ...» is in the position of the nominative as another khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو.
The clause «يسبّح له ما في السموات» is in the position of the nominative as another khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو [Note: Or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.]. The clause «هو العزيز ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl [Note: Or it is conjoined to the clause يسبّح.].

* Morphology:
(23) القدّوس: an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from (قدس), meaning "to be pure"; its pattern is فعّول, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and a doubled ʿayn with ḍamma.
(السلام) an adjective resembling the active participle from (سلم), i.e. "possessor of soundness"; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(24) المصوّر: an active participle of the four-letter verb (صوّر); its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
